verdict.rationale: Yapily documents scheduled, periodic and recurring payments, including variable recurring payments that run without re-authorisation each time, all via the Payments API. Webhooks report the status of these payments. This is domain-specific recurring execution rather than general job or workflow scheduling, and it is not available in Hosted Pages. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of jobs or workflows (e.g. recurring data pulls or automation triggers), detail on schedule configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
